meta.source: SCS website (src/app/globals.css, design tokens v0.5) and the SCS Company Growth Portfolio 2026 deck

color.note: One fixed light theme, as on the website (v0.5 is intentionally not adaptive to OS dark mode). Navy sections are made with the `.dark-surface` pattern, not a theme. deck-* tokens are the Growth Portfolio deck's palette for decks and print only.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Logo royal blue. Primary buttons, links, eyebrows on white, active nav text, metrics band. White text on it 9.1:1; it reads 9.1:1 on `bg` and 8.3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Navy. Hero, page-hero, process and closing bands, footer, utility bar, table heads; button hover for `primary`. Text on gold `accent` fills (9.8:1). Also the browser theme colour.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Logo gold. Rules (heading rule, card top borders, band edges), gold-fill buttons with `secondary` text, numerals. As TEXT only on `secondary` (9.8:1) or `primary` (5.2:1) — never on white (1.75:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, cards on `surface` sections, form inputs.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alternate section background (service hub, packages, why SCS), tags, post and lead cards, image wells.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `bg` (17.8:1) and `surface` (16.3:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Intros, card descriptions, hints and dates on `bg` (6.9:1) and `surface` (6.4:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline card, input, table and header borders on `bg`/`surface`. Decorative only: 1.3:1 on white, so it is below 3:1 for input outlines — the site's own value, kept exact.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations, verified badges, checklist ticks. Text on `bg` 5.0:1, on `surface` 4.6:1. Always paired with a word ("Request received.").

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Required-field asterisks, invalid inputs, form error messages. Text on `bg` 6.5:1. Always paired with a message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element over light surfaces (9:1 on white).

tokens.name: focus-ring-dark
tokens.usage: Focus outline inside `.dark-surface` (navy/blue) sections: gold reads 9.8:1 on `secondary`. Gold is never the ring on white.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Headings, stats and button text on `secondary` and `primary` bands.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Intros, breadcrumbs and footer links on `secondary` (12.5:1) and `primary` (7.0:1) — the site's white/85.

tokens.name: on-dark-outline
tokens.usage: Border of the outlineLight button on navy/blue bands (8.8:1 on `secondary`).

tokens.name: on-dark-divider
tokens.usage: Divider rules and the footer's bottom bar edge inside navy bands. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-dark-tint
tokens.usage: Delivery-mode tiles on navy (the site's white/5).

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Service-line chips in case studies (primary/10) with `primary` text (7.7:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Certificate lightbox backdrop (navy at 88%).

tokens.name: deck-paper
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: light slide background (cream).

tokens.name: deck-chip
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: chips and cards on `deck-paper`.

tokens.name: deck-ink
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: titles and chip text on `deck-paper` (16:1) and `deck-chip` (14.2:1).

tokens.name: deck-muted
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: body, footers and page numbers on `deck-paper` (6.3:1) and `deck-chip` (5.6:1).

tokens.name: deck-blue
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: section labels and eyebrows on `deck-paper` (6.3:1).

tokens.name: deck-gold
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: 'SERVICE 01 OF 21' eyebrows and section labels on `deck-night` (6.6:1). The deck also sets it on `deck-paper`, where it is only 2.5:1 — the deck's own pair, kept exact; prefer `deck-blue` there.

tokens.name: deck-night
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: dark slide background.

tokens.name: deck-night-card
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: chips, stat and service cards on `deck-night`.

tokens.name: deck-night-ink
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: titles and chip text on `deck-night` (15:1) and `deck-night-card` (12.8:1).

tokens.name: deck-night-muted
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: supporting copy on `deck-night` (8.8:1) and `deck-night-card` (7.5:1).

tokens.name: deck-night-gold
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: stats and eyebrows on `deck-night` (11.1:1).

tokens.name: deck-navy
tokens.usage: Decks & print only: theme accent; level-card fills on dark slides.

type.note: Website: Inter (Google Fonts, loaded by next/font). Decks: Fraunces for titles and big numbers, Public Sans for everything else. All three are hosted Google faces. Deck sizes are in points on the 960×540pt slide, written as px.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Build with structure. Operate with confidence.
styles.usage: Home hero H1 only (36px below 768px). White on `secondary`.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: PageHero H1 on inner pages (30px below 768px). One per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: SectionHeading titles and closing CTA (30px/36px below 768px).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Case-study, lead and leadership card titles; DeliveryModes heading.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Service-cluster, package, tool and post card titles; process step labels (uppercase, 0.025em).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: One partner. Multiple solutions. One business objective.
styles.usage: Section and hero intros (16px below 768px) in `muted`, or `on-dark-muted` on navy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We exist because most businesses do not fail from a lack of ambition.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Six areas of support, one accountable partner.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, footer links, tags, form labels (500).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kicker above titles: `primary` on light, `accent` on navy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE sector/category label on cards, in `primary`.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: StatCounter figures (36px below 768px), tabular numerals, white on `primary`.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: ProcessStepper numerals, tabular, `accent` on navy / `primary` on light.

styles.name: deck-cover-title
styles.sample: The Full Record of What We Build

styles.name: deck-body
styles.sample: Clients do not simply receive a document.

spacing.note: 8px base scale. The site adds no values outside it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps; tag inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Eyebrow-to-title gap, list item gaps, tag gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, card internal gaps, skip-link offset.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (p-6), grid gaps, paragraph spacing in prose.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (lg), full case-study padding, list indent.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section heading bottom margin region, PageHero vertical padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding (mobile py-16).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and closing band vertical padding (desktop py-24).

radius.note: Square-shouldered and restrained. Circles only for monograms, package numbers and progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, RC badges, heading rule, skip link.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, mega menu, image tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Leadership monogram, package number disc, progress bars, floating contact button.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows, separate surfaces. Shadows appear only on hover lift and overlays.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Card hover (`.lift`): with translateY(-3px), 0.2s ease. Off under reduced motion.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Services mega menu.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: ExternalLinkCard hover.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Cookie banner.

border.note: Border widths used by the site.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Card, input, table and header borders in `border`.

tokens.name: border-nav
tokens.usage: Nav underline: `accent` when active, transparent otherwise.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Gold top edge of cards, bottom edge of PageHero, top edge of footer and cookie banner; process step tops.

tokens.name: rule-width
tokens.usage: SectionHeading gold rule: 56px wide, 4px tall, `radius-sm`.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; gutters `space-3` / 24px / `space-5` at sm / md / lg.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Sticky header at md+ (72px on mobile).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, link-button and input (min-h-11).

tokens.name: measure-heading
tokens.usage: SectionHeading max width.

tokens.name: measure-body
tokens.usage: PageHero intro max width.
